title: French-Style Beef Stew
description: A classic French-inspired beef stew made with tender beef and a rich, zesty broth. Perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Season the beef with salt and black pepper.
Dredge the beef in flour to coat.
Heat a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef to the pot and sear until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the carrot and celery to the pot and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the mustard, wine, broth, bay leaves, and thyme to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 1/2 hours.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh thyme.
